name: Mystery structure
description: Genre-specific structure for puzzles, traces, wrong paths and resolution.

acts.title: The case begins
acts.description: Puzzles, first impressions and direction of investigation are established.

beats.title: Crime or mystery
beats.description: An unexplained event creates the central question.
guidingQuestions: What question needs to be answered?
What is at stake for those affected?

beats.title: First impression
beats.description: The visible location suggests a preliminary interpretation.

beats.title: First lead
beats.description: A concrete tip opens the active investigation.
guidingQuestions: Where does the trail apparently lead?

acts.title: Investigation and misdirection
acts.description: New clues expand the case and create a false sense of security.

beats.title: Wrong assumption
beats.description: A plausible interpretation steers the investigation in the wrong direction.
guidingQuestions: What detail does she already disagree with?

beats.title: New suspects
beats.description: Motives and opportunities expand the circle of possible responsible parties.
guidingQuestions: Which mysteries are not the solution you are looking for?

beats.title: contradiction
beats.description: An observation does not fit the preferred theory.
guidingQuestions: Which facts cannot be true at the same time?

beats.title: Central revelation
beats.description: A new truth orders traces and motifs differently.
guidingQuestions: Which track takes on new meaning?
Which person does this bring into focus?

beats.title: Setback
beats.description: Evidence is lost, an error becomes apparent or the other side takes action.

acts.title: Truth and resolution
acts.description: The hidden connection is recognized, proven and processed.

beats.title: Hidden connection
beats.description: Separate clues combine to form a viable solution.

beats.title: confrontation
beats.description: The truth discovered is put at risk against resistance.

beats.title: resolution
beats.description: The course of the crime, motive and open wrong paths are clarified in a comprehensible manner.

beats.title: Aftermath
beats.description: Consequences for investigators, those affected and order become visible.
guidingQuestions: Which order has been restored or lost?
